opportunities.title: Small Research Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Researchers from all countries globally; open to any researcher (not a scholarship).
opportunities.summary: Provides up to £5,000 to support new and innovative ecological research projects worldwide.

opportunities.title: Training and Travel Grants

amount.raw: Maximum £250 for virtual conferences/courses; up to £500 for in‑person events

opportunities.eligibility_summary: BES members who are PhD students or postgraduate researchers; must be studying at a university/research institution and work within ecology.
opportunities.summary: Supports PhD and postgraduate researchers to attend specialist field‑training courses or conferences, covering registration fees and travel costs.

opportunities.title: Pedagogical Research and Development Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: BES members involved in teaching ecology at any level; no geographic restriction.
opportunities.summary: Funds research into teaching and learning practices in ecology, aiming to improve ecological education and develop evidence‑based teaching methods.

opportunities.title: Long‑term Research Grants

amount.raw: £3,500 per year (first five years) with additional £3,500 in year six

opportunities.eligibility_summary: BES members; open to all ecologists (including conservation practitioners) applying as individuals.
opportunities.summary: Provides a small annual award to extend existing short‑term ecological projects into long‑term datasets over up to ten years.

opportunities.title: Synthesis Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: BES members (lead applicant) forming diverse groups of 8‑15 participants; open internationally.
opportunities.summary: Funds collaborative groups to synthesize existing ecological data, covering travel, meetings, data‑management and dissemination.

opportunities.title: Outreach and Engagement Grants
opportunities.eligibility_summary: BES members; open to individuals, teams or organisations of any nationality.
opportunities.summary: Supports public outreach and science‑communication activities that raise awareness of ecology, ecological careers, or promote action for the environment.

opportunities.title: Annual Meeting Grants 2026
opportunities.eligibility_summary: BES members who are citizens and based in a Global South country and have an accepted abstract for the BES Annual Meeting 2026.
opportunities.summary: Provides travel grants up to £1,000 for Global South researchers to attend the BES Annual Meeting, covering transport, registration and related costs.
